trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 10 to 30 pixels in vertical amplitude across the entire horizontal span of the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Numerous circular depressions and healed lesions consistent with external parasitic attachment points scattered across both ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced saw-tooth edge topography with non-uniform peak distribution.
